title: cmd/foo/deep: package x has no package comment
body:
Package without a package comment.

- `cmd/foo/deep/x.go:1`

Add a comment directly above the package clause that starts with "Package x" (https://go.dev/doc/comment).

title: cmd/foo/deep: Undoc has no doc comment
body:
Undocumented exported function `Undoc`.

- `cmd/foo/deep/x.go:3`

Add a comment directly above the declaration that starts with its name (https://go.dev/doc/comment); for a const/var block, a comment on the block documents every name in it.
